laws.statement: B1: The bridge forwards GET/POST requests to any x402 service URL and extracts USDC payment requirements from 402 responses
B2: The bridge converts USDC amounts from x402 402 responses into Nano raw equivalents using a live price feed
An ask holds asker, title, body and bounty_raw, transitioning open-to-paid-to-closed.
laws.oracle: cd /root/unstuck/opener && node -e "const n=require('./network.js'); let ok=true; try{n.createAsk({asker:'not_nano',title:'t',body:'b',bountyRaw:'1'}); ok=false;}catch(e){} try{n.createAsk({asker:'nano_A',title:'',body:'b',bountyRaw:'1'}); ok=false;}catch(e){} try{n.createAsk({asker:'nano_A',title:'t',body:'bo',bountyRaw:'-1'}); ok=false;}catch(e){} const a=n.createAsk({asker:'nano_A',title:'t',body:'b',bountyRaw:'1000000000000000000000000'}); try{n.transitionAsk(a,'open'); ok=false;}catch(e){} try{n.transitionAsk(a,'closed'); ok=false;}catch(e){} n.transitionAsk(a,'paid')==='paid'||(ok=false); console.log(ok?'N1-OK':'N1-FAIL')"

laws.statement: N2: Answerer standing counts distinct askers who accepted their answers, not raw volume.

N3: The network API server exposes ask lifecycle endpoints (POST /ask, GET /asks, GET /ask/:id, POST /ask/:id/answers, POST /ask/:id/accept) that create and retrieve asks via the network.js domain model
N4: The network API refuses invalid boundary actions: a non-Nano asker, answering a closed ask, and an asker accepting its own answer all return HTTP 400
N5: The network API persists asks to a SQLite store so they survive server restarts
laws.test: node test_network_store.js creates, retrieves and lists asks across server restarts

laws.statement: N6: The network HTTP server uses the persistent store so asks created via the API survive restarts
laws.test: node test_nserver_persist.js verifies ask lifecycle across server restart

laws.statement: L12: The network store records an on-chain settlement block hash for a paid (accepted) ask, refuses to settle a non-paid ask, and only a 64-hex block hash settles an ask.
Network standing counts only settled paid asks per distinct asker, exposed via POST /ask/:id/settle and GET /standing.
network-settle.js verifies an on-chain payment block exists, reaches the answerer, and covers the bounty.
NanoBazaar discovery module extracts Nano addresses from the public relay and records them as openable agent candidates in the openings database
laws.test: node nanobazaar-discover.js --check --save saves agent addresses to openings DB
laws.oracle: cd /root/unstuck/opener && node nanobazaar-discover.js --check 2>&1 | grep -c 'REACHED_NANOS' > /dev/null && echo OK || echo FAIL
